# Track fixtures

`bigRmskExample.bb` is the UCSC hg38 RepeatMasker example, retrieved from
https://users.wenglab.org/niship/bigRmskExample.bb on 2026-10-28. Its original
source and BED9+5 schema are documented at
https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/bigRmsk.html. Tests serve its bytes
locally through mocked HTTP range responses and make no external requests.
